I'm working in /opt/nxeon-staging (a Next.js app for Nxeon, a VPS/game-hosting platform). I need to add a brand-new "game family" called plutoniumt4 (Plutonium T4/WaW private server hosting) into the existing game-server catalog system, but I want it to appear in a distinct "specialty/community servers" section rather than mixed into the flagship game grid.

Please research and report back (do not edit anything, this is read-only research):

1. Every file that imports or references `GAME_FAMILIES` from lib/games.ts (the array of family ids). List each file and briefly what it does with the list (e.g., iterates to render a grid, validates an order, etc).
2. The structure of `app/game-servers/page.tsx` (or wherever the /game-servers hub lives) — how does it enumerate/render the games grid? Is there any existing pattern for "featured" vs "other" or "specialty" categorization I could reuse or extend?
3. How does the checkout/deploy wizard (e.g. app/dashboard/deploy/page.tsx) pick up new GamePlan rows to make an order actually work end-to-end — does it just query GamePlan from Prisma filtered by active=true, and does it need the family to be in GAME_FAMILIES to render properly, or is there anything else (e.g. GameCoverCarousel.tsx, GameLogo.tsx GAME_VISUAL map) that would need a new entry or otherwise break/show a placeholder if a new family is added?
4. Check lib/game-control.ts's GAME_CONTROL record - is every GameFamily required to have an entry (i.e., would TypeScript fail to compile without adding a plutoniumt4 entry there too)? What's the minimal valid entry for a family with rcon: "none"?
5. Check app/sitemap.ts to see the pattern for how individual game/product pages get added to the sitemap (is it a per-family list, and are there recent examples like a wave9 game's dedicated landing page, or do most families NOT get individual landing pages, only appearing in the /game-servers grid?).
6. Check whether there's an existing "template" for a single-game dedicated landing page (e.g. search app/ for any page like app/(marketing)/*/page.tsx for a specific single game with its own URL, e.g. minecraft or an AI-hosting/tools template page mentioned in code comments) that I could use as a structural reference for a new page at app/plutonium-t4-hosting/page.tsx or similar. Report the exact file path of the best reference template and briefly its layout structure (hero section props, pricing section, FAQ, etc).

Report back concisely with exact file paths and line numbers/snippets where relevant. Keep it organized by question number. This is investigation only — do not write or edit any files.

397	/**
398	 * Locate the first existing file: explicit candidates via `test -f`, then a
399	 * bounded `find` over `roots`. Candidate paths are compile-time constants; the
400	 * returned hit is re-validated against the path allowlist before any caller uses
401	 * it. Returns null when nothing matches.
402	 */
403	export async function remoteLocateFile(
404	  conn: Client,
405	  candidates: string[],
406	  roots: string[],
407	  name: string
408	): Promise<string | null> {
409	  const testExpr = candidates.map((p) => `if [ -f ${shq(p)} ]; then echo ${shq(p)}; exit 0; fi;`).join(" ");
410	  const findExpr = roots.length
411	    ? `for r in ${roots.map((r) => shq(r)).join(" ")}; do [ -d "$r" ] && find "$r" -maxdepth 6 -type f -name ${shq(name)} 2>/dev/null | head -1; done | head -1`
412	    : "true";
413	  const { stdout } = await exec(conn, `${testExpr} ${findExpr}`, QUICK_TIMEOUT_MS);
414	  const hit = stdout
415	    .split(/\r?\n/)
416	    .map((s) => s.trim())
417	    .find((s) => s.length > 0);
418	  return hit && isSafeRemotePath(hit) ? hit : null;
419	}

440	/** Parse a `key=value` / `key value` config into a lowercase-keyed map. */
441	function parseFlatConfig(text: string): Record<string, string> {
442	  const out: Record<string, string> = {};
443	  for (const line of text.split(/\r?\n/)) {
444	    const t = line.trim();
445	    if (!t || t.startsWith("#") || t.startsWith("//") || t.startsWith("!") || t.startsWith(";")) continue;
446	    let key: string;
447	    let val: string;
448	    const eq = t.indexOf("=");
449	    if (eq >= 0) {
450	      key = t.slice(0, eq).trim();
451	      val = t.slice(eq + 1).trim();
452	    } else {
453	      const sp = t.search(/\s/);
454	      if (sp < 0) continue;
455	      key = t.slice(0, sp).trim();
456	      val = t.slice(sp + 1).trim();
457	    }
458	    // Strip surrounding quotes.
459	    val = val.replace(/^"(.*)"$/, "$1").replace(/^'(.*)'$/, "$1");
460	    if (key) out[key.toLowerCase()] = val;
461	  }
462	  return out;
463	}

465	/** Pull `Key=Value` pairs out of Palworld's `OptionSettings=(...)` blob. */
466	function parsePalworldIni(text: string): Record<string, string> {
467	  const out: Record<string, string> = {};
468	  const idx = text.indexOf("OptionSettings=(");
469	  const open = idx >= 0 ? text.indexOf("(", idx) : -1;
470	  const close = open >= 0 ? text.indexOf(")", open) : -1;
471	  if (open < 0 || close < 0) return out;
472	  const inner = text.slice(open + 1, close);
473	  let cur = "";
474	  let inQuote = false;
475	  const pairs: string[] = [];
476	  for (const ch of inner) {
477	    if (ch === '"') inQuote = !inQuote;
478	    if (ch === "," && !inQuote) {
479	      pairs.push(cur);
480	      cur = "";
481	    } else cur += ch;
482	  }
483	  if (cur) pairs.push(cur);
484	  for (const p of pairs) {
485	    const eq = p.indexOf("=");
486	    if (eq < 0) continue;
487	    let v = p.slice(eq + 1).trim();
488	    v = v.replace(/^"(.*)"$/, "$1");
489	    out[p.slice(0, eq).trim().toLowerCase()] = v;
490	  }
491	  return out;
492	}

498	/**
499	 * Read a game server's RCON credentials out of its own config file, over SSH.
500	 * The password is used ONLY as a Source RCON packet body downstream — never a
501	 * shell argument — and the port is parsed to an integer (`parsePort`), so neither
502	 * value can inject anywhere.
503	 */
504	export async function readRconCreds(conn: Client, spec: GameControlSpec): Promise<RconCreds> {
505	  const cfg = spec.rconConfig;
506	  if (spec.rcon !== "source" || !cfg) {
507	    return { ok: false, reason: `Remote console is not available for ${spec.label}.` };
508	  }
509	  const path = await remoteLocateFile(conn, cfg.candidates, cfg.findRoots, cfg.findName);
510	  if (!path) return { ok: false, reason: `Could not find ${spec.label}'s config file to read RCON settings.` };
511	  const text = await readRemoteText(conn, path);
512	  if (text == null) return { ok: false, reason: `Could not read ${spec.label}'s config file.` };
513	
514	  const map = cfg.kind === "palworld-ini" ? parsePalworldIni(text) : parseFlatConfig(text);
515	
516	  if (cfg.enableKey) {
517	    const en = (map[cfg.enableKey.toLowerCase()] ?? "").toLowerCase();
518	    if (en !== "true" && en !== "1" && en !== "on") {
519	      return { ok: false, reason: `RCON is not enabled in ${spec.label}'s config — enable it and restart to use the console.` };
520	    }
521	  }
522	  const password = map[cfg.passwordKey.toLowerCase()] ?? "";
523	  if (!password) return { ok: false, reason: `No RCON password is set in ${spec.label}'s config.` };
524	  if (password.length > 256) return { ok: false, reason: "RCON password in the config looks malformed." };
525	
526	  const port = cfg.portKey ? parsePort(map[cfg.portKey.toLowerCase()]) ?? cfg.defaultPort : cfg.defaultPort;
527	  return { ok: true, port, password };
528	}

534	const RCON_TYPE_AUTH = 3;
535	const RCON_TYPE_EXEC = 2;
536	const RCON_TYPE_RESPONSE = 0;
537	const RCON_ID_AUTH = 0x1;
538	const RCON_ID_CMD = 0x2;
539	const RCON_ID_END = 0x2711; // sentinel id for the trailing empty packet
540	
541	function rconPacket(id: number, type: number, body: string): Buffer {
542	  const bodyBuf = Buffer.from(body, "ascii");
543	  const buf = Buffer.alloc(bodyBuf.length + 14);
544	  buf.writeInt32LE(bodyBuf.length + 10, 0); // size = id(4)+type(4)+body+2 nulls
545	  buf.writeInt32LE(id, 4);
546	  buf.writeInt32LE(type, 8);
547	  bodyBuf.copy(buf, 12);
548	  // two trailing NUL bytes already zero from Buffer.alloc
549	  return buf;
550	}

552	/**
553	 * Open a TCP channel to `host:port` on the game VM THROUGH the authenticated SSH
554	 * connection. The RCON port therefore never needs to be reachable off the box.
555	 */
556	export function forwardTcp(conn: Client, host: string, port: number, timeoutMs = 8000): Promise<Duplex> {
557	  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
558	    const timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error("Timed out opening RCON channel")), timeoutMs);
559	    conn.forwardOut("127.0.0.1", 0, host, port, (err, stream) => {
560	      clearTimeout(timer);
561	      if (err) return reject(err);
562	      resolve(stream as unknown as Duplex);
563	    });
564	  });
565	}

567	export type RconResult = { ok: true; response: string } | { ok: false; error: string };
568	
569	/**
570	 * Speak Source RCON over `stream`: authenticate, run `command`, and read the
571	 * (possibly multi-packet) response, using a trailing empty packet as the
572	 * end-of-response sentinel. Never throws — resolves an {ok,error} result. The
573	 * password is only ever a packet body; the command was validated by the caller.
574	 */
575	export function sourceRcon(stream: Duplex, password: string, command: string, timeoutMs = 8000): Promise<RconResult> {
576	  return new Promise((resolve) => {
577	    let acc = Buffer.alloc(0);
578	    let authed = false;
579	    let response = "";
580	    let done = false;
581	
582	    const finish = (r: RconResult) => {
583	      if (done) return;
584	      done = true;
585	      clearTimeout(timer);
586	      try {
587	        stream.end();
588	      } catch {
589	        /* best effort */
590	      }
591	      resolve(r);
592	    };
593	    const timer = setTimeout(
594	      () => finish(authed ? { ok: true, response } : { ok: false, error: "RCON timed out (no response)." }),
595	      timeoutMs
596	    );
597	
598	    stream.on("data", (chunk: Buffer) => {
599	      acc = Buffer.concat([acc, chunk]);
600	      while (acc.length >= 4) {
601	        const size = acc.readInt32LE(0);
602	        if (size < 10 || size > 4110) return finish({ ok: false, error: "Malformed RCON response." });
603	        if (acc.length < size + 4) break;
604	        const id = acc.readInt32LE(4);
605	        const type = acc.readInt32LE(8);
606	        const body = acc.slice(12, 4 + size - 2).toString("ascii");
607	        acc = acc.slice(4 + size);
608	
609	        if (!authed) {
610	          // The auth response is a type-2 (AUTH_RESPONSE) packet; id === -1 on failure.
611	          if (type === RCON_TYPE_EXEC) {
612	            if (id === -1) return finish({ ok: false, error: "RCON authentication failed (wrong password)." });
613	            authed = true;
614	            stream.write(rconPacket(RCON_ID_CMD, RCON_TYPE_EXEC, command));
615	            stream.write(rconPacket(RCON_ID_END, RCON_TYPE_EXEC, "")); // sentinel
616	          }
617	          // A leading empty RESPONSE_VALUE some servers send pre-auth is ignored.
618	        } else {
619	          if (id === RCON_ID_END) return finish({ ok: true, response });
620	          if (type === RCON_TYPE_RESPONSE) response += body;
621	        }
622	      }
623	    });
624	    stream.on("error", (e: Error) => finish({ ok: false, error: e?.message || "RCON connection error." }));
625	    stream.on("close", () => finish(authed ? { ok: true, response } : { ok: false, error: "RCON connection closed." }));
626	
627	    stream.write(rconPacket(RCON_ID_AUTH, RCON_TYPE_AUTH, password));
628	  });
629	}

631	/**
632	 * Full inline RCON round-trip on an already-open SSH connection: read creds from
633	 * the server's config, tunnel to 127.0.0.1:<port>, run one command. Callers guard
634	 * SANDBOX and ownership before reaching here.
635	 */
636	export async function runRcon(conn: Client, spec: GameControlSpec, command: string): Promise<RconResult> {
637	  const creds = await readRconCreds(conn, spec);
638	  if (!creds.ok) return { ok: false, error: creds.reason };
639	  let stream: Duplex;
640	  try {
641	    stream = await forwardTcp(conn, "127.0.0.1", creds.port);
642	  } catch (e) {
643	    return { ok: false, error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not open RCON channel." };
644	  }
645	  return sourceRcon(stream, creds.password, command);
646	}

660	 * nothing, falls back to a `.log` file under the data roots. Read-only.
661	 */
662	export async function readGameLogs(conn: Client, spec: GameControlSpec, n = 200): Promise<LogResult> {
663	  const lines = Math.min(Math.max(Math.trunc(n) || 200, 20), 500);
664	  const hints = spec.serviceHints.map(shq).join(" ");
665	  const roots = spec.dataRoots.map(shq).join(" ");
666	  const script = [
667	    `unit=""`,
668	    `for c in ${hints}; do systemctl cat "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 && { unit="$c"; break; }; done`,
669	    `if [ -z "$unit" ]; then unit=$(systemctl list-units --type=service --plain --no-legend 2>/dev/null | grep -i ${shq(spec.family)} | head -1 | awk '{print $1}'); fi`,
670	    `echo "NXLOG:UNIT:${"$"}{unit:-none}"`,
671	    `if [ -n "$unit" ]; then journalctl -u "$unit" -n ${lines} --no-pager 2>/dev/null; fi`,
672	    // Fallback: newest *.log under the data roots (bounded).
673	    `f=""; for r in ${roots}; do [ -d "$r" ] && f=$(find "$r" -maxdepth 4 -type f -name '*.log' 2>/dev/null | head -1) && [ -n "$f" ] && break; done`,
674	    `if [ -n "$f" ]; then echo "NXLOG:FILE:$f"; tail -n ${lines} "$f" 2>/dev/null; fi`,
675	  ].join("\n");
676	  const { stdout } = await exec(conn, script, QUICK_TIMEOUT_MS);
677	  const all = stdout.split(/\r?\n/);
678	  let unit: string | null = null;
679	  const out: string[] = [];
680	  for (const l of all) {
681	    const m = /^NXLOG:UNIT:(.*)$/.exec(l);
682	    if (m) {
683	      unit = m[1] === "none" ? null : m[1];
684	      continue;
685	    }
686	    if (/^NXLOG:FILE:/.test(l)) continue;
687	    out.push(l);
688	  }
689	  while (out.length && out[out.length - 1].trim() === "") out.pop();
690	  return { ok: true, lines: out.slice(-lines), unit };
691	}

705	  const { stdout } = await exec(conn, script, QUICK_TIMEOUT_MS);

712	    if (!name) continue;

766	      return { players: names.map((name) => ({ name })), raw };
767	    }

769	    const m2 = /players online\.\s*\n.*?:\s*(.+)$/im.exec(clean);
770	    if (m2) {

772	      return { players: names.map((name) => ({ name })), raw };
